_comment: Per-audit Lighthouse SCORE floors (0-100), not millisecond ceilings and not bytes. This object is the single source of what the gate covers: evaluate.mjs gates exactly Object.keys(floors), so a metric cannot be silently dropped by editing a second list somewhere else.
_whyNoInp: INP is deliberately absent. It is a field metric that needs real interaction; Lighthouse's lab proxy for it is total-blocking-time, which IS gated above. Gating an audit named 'inp' from a lab run would claim a measurement nobody took. The backlog's 'INP <=200ms' is answered by the TBT floor. Spec §3.2.
_whyNoBytes: There is no byte budget here, deliberately — not as a blocker and not as a warning. The backlog's '<=170 KB initial JS' was deleted by operator decision on 2026-09-12, because the same build scores 68 and 100 on two throttling profiles without a byte changing. Spec §1.2. A future byte budget must be re-argued from a measurement.
